description: Use this tool to see the gigs and prices a named seller currently has published, once you already have their username. Only published gigs are included, so a page may return fewer than `limit` items — keep requesting pages until `has_next_page` is `false`.

end_cursor.description: An opaque string used for cursor-based pagination. To fetch the next page of results, pass the cursor value returned in the pagination metadata of your previous request.

limit.description: Maximum number of gigs to return (10–50, default 20).

name: list_seller_gigs
